tools.name: get_connected_purchase
tools.description: Identifies the existing Ocolta purchase connected to this conversation. Returns its label, whether it is a synthetic reviewer fixture, the number of unused reviews, and the supported report-summary access. Does not expose payment details or account identifiers.

tools.name: list_recent_reviews
tools.description: Lists the review IDs of up to ten completed Deep Reviews from the connected purchase that are still within the 24-hour recovery period after completion, most recent first. Does not start a review or spend a credit.

tools.name: get_review_summary
tools.description: Returns the categorical status, review priority, confidence, fraud and AI-generation assessments, indicator counts and limitation count for one recoverable review from the connected purchase, with a fixed disclaimer.
